scientific_execution_status: not_started; B03 performed data inventory only, with no model fit or tests

candidates.question: On independent physical textile groups with auditable composition labels, how do classical NIR composition estimation, direct proxy-eligibility classification and an existing binary precision/review policy compare on observed false acceptance versus automatic coverage for one dated composition-only profile?
candidates.exact_added_component: A transparent, source-scoped textile composition-proxy target and grouped risk/coverage evaluation with explicit REVIEW for unknown labels or unobserved whole-item conditions; no novel estimator or guarantee asserted.
mandatory_comparators: simple classical NIR PLS score plus fixed threshold
direct binary eligibility classifier with an ordinary reject threshold
existing MAPIE/LTT-style precision controller only if independent calibration is feasible
candidates.falsification_condition: Abandon claimed added value if no independent groups lie clearly on both sides and near the profile threshold, if label ambiguity changes the target, if the simple PLS/threshold comparator matches or dominates the policy at the same information and review budget, or if uncertainty intervals are too wide for a useful conclusion.
candidates.data_prerequisite: B03 verifies file license, physical group IDs and dependence; enough disjoint eligible/ineligible and near-boundary specimens after train/selection/calibration/evaluation separation; composition metadata with uncertainty represented rather than silent zeros.
candidates.maximum_initial_pilot_budget: One audited small metadata table and mean-spectrum subset, one chosen profile, up to three low-compute model families, at most two preregistered review rules; development data only. This is a plan, not an authorized test execution.
candidates.claim_if_supported: Measured proxy-label risk/coverage on the audited sample population, with confidence limits and a no-guarantee caveat.

candidates.question: Can a grouped classical NIR baseline reproduce a source-scoped composition or blend-identification task on an accessible textile dataset, and where do label provenance, instrument and specimen dependence limit its interpretation?
candidates.exact_added_component: Reproducible dataset and evaluation audit across the best accessible source, with a preregistered comparison to its published/simple PLS result; no algorithmic novelty asserted.
mandatory_comparators: published source-specific PLS or classical baseline
majority or simple spectral rule where meaningful
candidates.falsification_condition: Report only an audit if no suitable labeled independent groups or lawful data access exist; do not present a routine reproduction as a new sorter or a process improvement.
candidates.data_prerequisite: B03 compares OpenTextile, NIST NIR-SORT 2.0 and any actually released HyperTex files for license, labels, group IDs, size and accessible spectral format; chemical-reference status is separately recorded.
candidates.maximum_initial_pilot_budget: One source and one classical baseline on audited mean spectra, bounded to the local machine; no 161.5 GB HyperTex transfer or full HSI matrix by default. This is a plan, not an authorized test execution.
candidates.claim_if_supported: A reproduced or failed published proxy-label result with explicit differences in data and protocol.
candidates.selected_dataset: OpenTextile-NIR v1.0 small mean-spectrum tables; 71 pieces / 70 conservative parent groups; supplier nominal labels, no chemical assay

pilot_execution_note: No tests, experiments, toy examples or model fits were created or run in B02 under the current testing preference.
B03_decision: H02-2 selected for future exploratory grouped audit/reproduction; H02-1 risk-control claim not feasible on current verified OpenTextile data
